summary: Monday's session stayed tethered to rates: 10-year real yields held near 2.6%, above their recent average, and a firm dollar near 99.6 pushed gold to a two-week low and kept Treasury duration under pressure. Equity gains stayed narrow as defensive staples lagged growth, while bitcoin's 30-day rally cooled on thinning volume.
tweet: Elevated real yields and a firm dollar pressured gold and bonds Monday, while thin equity breadth and cooling crypto momentum kept sentiment mixed.
